arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
xl = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')
print('Sheets:', xl.sheet_names)
for sheet in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(xl, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f'\n--- Sheet: {sheet} ({df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} cols) ---')
    print(df.to_string())
"

python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
expenses = df.iloc[10:22, 2]  # rows 11-22 (0-indexed 10:22), column C
print('Expense rows (Category | Item | Amount):')
total = 0
for _, row in df.iloc[10:22].iterrows():
    amt = row[2]
    total += amt
    print(f'  {row[0]:<15} {row[1]:<15} {amt:>8.2f}')
print(f'\nTotal Expenses = {total:,.2f}')
print('Formula in C23:', '=SUM(C11:C22)' if True else '')
# Cross-check via openpyxl formula
from openpyxl import load_workbook
wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx')
ws = wb['Budget']
print('C23 formula:', ws['C23'].value)
